description: Resolve (mint) a Talvio Dot Robot NFT in DOTFIELD on BNB Chain - 10,000 units (Prime 3,000 / Pixel Dot 2,800 / Stealth Dot 2,700 / Aurum Dot 1,500), released on a daily Charge Day cycle. Free resolve 1 unit/day for Binance Agent ID holders (0 BNB, requires answering the on-chain question from questionFor first), paid ladder mintPaid (units 2-5 at 0.00026 BNB, units 6-10 at 0.001 BNB, max 10/day), DPASS buyPass at 0.0012 BNB, and discharge of sealed units to claim $DOT. Field No 1 sealed OVERDRIVE (157 units, 155 wallets); a new Field opens daily at 12:00 UTC and the free quota can fill within minutes. Use when your human wants a Talvio Dot Robot or asks you to resolve/mint one in DOTFIELD.
